help.cedarloom:
Usage: cedarloom <command> [options]
cloom is a short name for cedarloom.

Commands:
  doctor           Check that this computer can run CedarLoom.
  runs list        List the runs recorded for this project.
  runs show <run>  Show a run and its steps.
  undo <run>       Undo a run, as a run of its own.

Options:
  --json           Print one JSON document instead of text.
  --help, -h       Show the usage of a command.
  --version, -V    Print the version of CedarLoom.
help.doctor:
Usage: cedarloom doctor [--json]

Checks that this computer can run CedarLoom: the Node.js version.
help.runs:
Usage: cedarloom runs <verb> [options]

Verbs:
  list        List the runs recorded for this project, newest first.
  show <run>  Show a run and its steps.
help.runs-list:
Usage: cedarloom runs list [--json]

Lists the runs recorded for this project, newest first.
help.runs-show:
Usage: cedarloom runs show <run> [--json]

Shows the run <run> and its steps.
help.undo:
Usage: cedarloom undo <run> [--yes] [--json]

Undoes the run <run> as a run of its own. Without --yes it shows the plan and changes nothing.
output.runs-none: No runs are recorded for this project.
output.undo-no-steps: Every file is already as before run
